NeoFair in Pallavaram, Chennai

A beautiful occasion
starts with a clear plan.

A wedding morning has many moving parts: the outfit, jewellery, hairstyle and the moment you need to be ready. At our beauty parlour in Pallavaram, Chennai, use the first conversation to bring those details together. The same thoughtful planning can shape an engagement look, party makeup or a simple hair appointment before a family gathering.

NeoFair Salon & Aesthetics is upstairs from KFC at Vaidhyalingam Complex on 200 Feet Radial Road. For anyone comparing a beauty parlour near Chromepet or planning from Old Pallavaram, the Radial Road address gives you a clear place to start checking your route.

There is room for everyday beauty here too. Women’s haircuts, hair colour, facials, nails and grooming services sit alongside the occasion menu. Choose the services relevant to your day and confirm the specialist, schedule and quote with the Pallavaram branch. A premium experience begins with knowing how your visit will come together.

Your Chennai celebration, thoughtfully planned

One celebration.
Every detail connected.

When planning bridal makeup in Pallavaram, a useful brief connects the look to the real schedule of your day.

Share your wedding schedule ↗

Build the brief around each event.

Write down the ceremony, engagement or reception you are booking for, the venue and the time you must be ready. Add an outfit photograph and note any change of saree or jewellery between events. A traditional wedding look and a lighter reception finish may require separate planning. Ask the team to confirm which services are included for each event rather than assuming a single makeup booking covers every change.

Use the trial to explore the whole look.

For a bridal makeup trial in Pallavaram, bring references that show what you like about the eyes, lip colour and overall coverage. Include the intended hairstyle, hair accessories and jewellery when available. Discuss comfort and personal preferences as well as how the look appears in photographs. Ask what the trial includes, whether the intended event artist is available and how any agreed changes will be recorded for the final appointment.

Work backwards from the ready-by time.

Decide whether you are requesting in-salon preparation on Radial Road or asking about a venue arrangement. Confirm travel requirements, draping, hair styling and any additional services before making the rest of the schedule. For visits from Chromepet, Pammal or Keelkattalai, check your route for the day and allow time for arrival. Family-member makeup requests should be listed separately so the branch can confirm capacity and timing for everyone.

Where is NeoFair on Pallavaram Radial Road?+

Find the salon upstairs from KFC at Vaidhyalingam Complex, 200 Feet Radial Road, Thiyagi P.V., Pallavaram, Tambaram, Chennai 600117, as listed by NeoFair. Call +91 74486 68744 for entrance guidance.

How do I book bridal makeup and hairstyling in Pallavaram?+

Share the event date, venue, ready-by time and the hair and makeup look you want. Include saree draping and any additional functions in the request. The branch must confirm artist availability, the agreed services and a quote before the booking is final.

Can I enquire about an airbrush bridal makeup trial?+

NeoFair’s menu lists airbrush makeup and trial makeup. Ask the Pallavaram branch which trial arrangement is available, what it includes and whether it involves the artist intended for your event. Confirm these details before reserving a trial.

Are engagement and reception looks planned separately?+

They can involve different outfits, jewellery and hairstyles, so describe each function separately when enquiring. Ask whether a look change requires another time block or artist arrangement and request clear inclusions and pricing for each part.

Can I include saree draping and a bridal hairstyle?+

Both draping and hair requirements should be named in your enquiry. Send references for a braid, bun or updo and describe the saree and accessories. Confirm who supplies flowers, hair ornaments and any additional styling items.

Can makeup be arranged at a wedding venue in Chennai?+

Ask Pallavaram directly about your exact venue and schedule. Off-site service is not assumed by this page. Artist availability, travel, setup requirements and charges must be confirmed with the branch before you plan around a venue booking.

When should I arrange a facial before my function?+

Tell the team the function date, services you are considering and any sensitivities or recent treatments. Ask for timing guidance for the selected cosmetic service rather than booking several unfamiliar services together without a discussion.

Can I request bridal nail art in Pallavaram?+

Yes, you can enquire using a design reference, preferred length and outfit colours. The NeoFair menu includes gel polish, extensions and decorative nail options. Confirm specialist availability and whether existing product removal is required.

Can I visit for a regular haircut rather than a bridal service?+

Yes. The broader menu includes women’s cuts, styling, hair colour, hair spa, facials and grooming. State the everyday service you want and contact the branch for its current availability, price and appointment time.

How do I plan a visit from Chromepet or Pammal?+

Use the directions link to the Pallavaram salon and confirm the appointment before setting out. For bridal preparation, work backwards from the agreed ready-by time and check the route from your own address. The form prepares an enquiry; it does not automatically reserve a slot.
